lede: Looking for Heavy Duty Storage Racks in Dubai?
about: Established in 2013, Allied Technical Services L.L.C is one of the fastest growing companies in the Gulf, and is present in diverse domains such as Shelving, Racking, Flooring, Gypsum partitions and Fabrication as an Internet Group and a Special Service Division in the Gulf.

A Group always ensures that all its entities exceed the expectations of customers through offering stringent quality products and services at highly competitive prices and through excellent customer service. The company has also left no stone unturned to satisfy the needs of the its clients and business partners.
